description: Ministry  of Labour & Trade Union Relations -  Notice of Industrial Disputes between Inter Company  Employees Union vs. Ceylon Holiday Resorts Limited, and All Ceylon Commercial and Industrial Workers Union vs. Arthur c. Clarke Institute for Modern Technologies
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of statutory powers under the Industrial Disputes Act to appoint arbitrators for industrial disputes. It contains legal orders made by the Minister under specific legislative authority, references to amended acts, and formal legal procedures for dispute resolution. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory function being performed rather than constituting a personnel appointment with detailed portfolio responsibilities. The core content is regulatory action under existing legislation.
